audit.whatIsWrong: Six of seven rows contradicted the page's own why-strings: the chart said Skill at level 1 where whys[0] says 'You win Level 1', Yorick at 2 and 3 where whys[1] and whys[2] say skill/even, Skill at 4-5 where whys[3] says it tilts his way, Skill at 6 where whys[4] says your Maiden flips it, and Yorick at 2+ items where whys[6] says 'late goes to him'.
audit.why: The packet chart reads Yorick, Skill, Skill, K'Sante, Yorick, Yorick, K'Sante — identical to what the whys already describe. Two independent sources agree, so the sides layer was the only thing out of step.
audit.corrected: win[0]/phases[0].side to Yorick, win[1] and win[2] to Skill, win[3] to K'Sante, win[4] to Yorick, win[6] to K'Sante, each with its phases[N].side pair; ratings 6/10, 4/10, 7/10, 3/10 on the rows that moved.

audit.whatIsWrong: Every phases[N].why was generic boilerplate ('your core pattern starts now', 'trade around All Out's cooldown'), and after the row fixes four of them said the opposite of their own row.
audit.why: The real spikes are: level 1 to Yorick because Last Rites is an attack reset that heals while Ntofo Strikes needs two stacks; 4-5 to K'Sante when the second Ntofo stack pulls and Path Maker stuns for true damage on 14s; 6 to Yorick because Maiden is permanent and All Out is 120s at rank 1; 2+ items to K'Sante because All Out launches you through walls.
audit.corrected: Rewrote phases[0..4].why and phases[6].why to those spikes with the real cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: Flagged defect — no cooldown sequencing anywhere. All Out was described only as 'his duelist mode', and the page never states the interaction that decides the matchup: All Out knocks you through any wall in your path, which includes your own Dark Procession.
audit.why: Riot's text: 'K'Sante knocks an enemy back, launching them through any wall in their path.' Your cage is a wall, so placing it behind yourself hands him a free displacement — the one thing a Yorick would never guess. All Out is 120s at rank 1 and heals him. Path Maker is 14s at rank 1 and deals true damage, so armour is the wrong answer, and while he is All Out it no longer knocks back or stuns. Footwork is a 10s dash plus shield.
audit.corrected: The wall interaction, All Out's cooldown and heal, Path Maker's true damage and Footwork's cooldown into breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d, dontsFull[0].d, dontsFull[1].d, report[5].t and the itemization line.

edits.before: You have nothing yet — just bank graves off the wave. Identify how K'Sante contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Last Rites resets your attack and heals; his Ntofo Strikes needs two stacks to do anything, so the first trade is yours.

edits.before: E mark plus the first ghoul wave starts real trades. Only take the trade when K'Sante's All Out is down.
edits.after: His first Ntofo charge pokes back on a 3.5s cooldown — even trades until your ghoul count climbs.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so K'Sante must walk into your engage range.
edits.after: Even: Mourning Mist shreds armour at 700 range, but Footwork is a 10s dash and shield that answers a single mark.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around All Out's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: His window: two Ntofo stacks pull you in and Path Maker stuns for true damage on 14s — armour does not answer that.

edits.before: Maiden turns the lane into a permanent 2v1. Reassess every all-in at 6 — K'Sante's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Maiden turns the lane into a permanent 2v1, and All Out is 120s at rank 1 — his only answer is on a long timer.

edits.before: Two items on: your side-lane pattern is at full power. K'Sante carry threat 7/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: All Out flings you through any wall in your path — including your own cage — so close the game before he catches you off Maiden.

edits.before: - K'Sante All Out: matchup-defining — His duelist mode. Swarm when it’s down. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - K'Sante All Out: 120s at rank 1 — it knocks you through any wall, your own cage included, then heals him. - Path Maker: 14s at rank 1, true damage, and no stun once he is All Out. - Footwork: 10s dash and shield.

edits.before: His duelist mode. Swarm when it’s down. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: All Out is 120s at rank 1 and heals him — swarm him during the downtime.

edits.before: That is K'Sante's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: Two Ntofo stacks fire a shockwave that pulls you in — break the stack first.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: All Out heals him as it lands — anti-heal before you commit low.

edits.before: Track K'Sante's All Out: His duelist mode. Swarm when it’s down. When it is down — Cage + swarm him.
edits.after: All Out: 120s at rank 1. It launches you through any wall in your path — your Dark Procession included.

edits.before: Start Doran's Blade + pot. Core: Trinity Force  (the all-purpose spike), then Hullbreaker; boots Plated Steelcaps. Executioner's Calling early — his healing fights your pattern.
edits.after: Start Doran's Blade + pot. Core: Trinity Force (the all-purpose spike), then Hullbreaker; boots Plated Steelcaps. Executioner's Calling — All Out heals him and Path Maker is true damage.
